subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, Gateway, UI, hook, and plugin SDK lifecycle contract, or should yielded-parent waiting remain an internal runtime state?
rationale: The observable bug needs repair, but the patch also commits multiple external surfaces to a new status and classifier; code correctness cannot decide whether that permanent product/API expansion is desired.

options.title: Split core fix from contracts
options.body: Land the task, wake, delivery, and Discord lifecycle repair first, then review public `deferred` and SDK surfaces in a separate compatibility PR.

options.title: Approve the broad contract
options.body: Keep all public surfaces after adding explicit semantics, compatibility tests, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Remove the public status and SDK expansion while preserving internal yielded-parent orchestration behavior.

recommendation.title: Split core fix from contracts
recommendation.body: Land the task, wake, delivery, and Discord lifecycle repair first, then review public `deferred` and SDK surfaces in a separate compatibility PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared decision spans the agent lifecycle and announce ownership boundaries established by this person's major refactors, beyond any single cron, task, or Discord file.
